svg.text: T-TRAK N-scale coal mine set: Triple A | Double B | Triple C
Kato Unitrack, #4 turnouts (EP481-15). 12 turnouts, 1 square = 100 mm. Empties arrive on the left, are loaded under the tipple and leave as loads on the right.
Triple, 928 x 355 mm box, 930 mm of track per line
Double, 618 x 355 mm box, 620 mm of track per line
Triple, 928 x 355 mm box, 930 mm of track per line
Capacity (102 mm hoppers): Track 1 6 empty + 6 loaded, Track 2 5 empty + 5 loaded, Track 3 4 empty + 4 loaded, Track 4 3 empty + 3 loaded. Total 18 empties + 18 loads under/around the tipple.
Track spacing: mains 33 mm (T-TRAK), lead and tracks 1-4 at Kato's #4 ladder spacing (32.6-32.8 mm). Track 4 centre is 247 mm from the front edge, leaving 96 mm of scenery at the back.
Orange dots = turnout points (L/R = Kato hand). Light ticks = Unitrack joints. Red dashed lines = module joints (yard tracks cross them).
Structures are footprints for planning only. FRONT EDGE (viewer side) is at the bottom.
